openDefect.symptom: Same-plan five-clause bulk call committed three revisions and deadlocked two. Readback confirmed the failed clauses unchanged before sequential recovery.
openDefect.rootCause: Confirmed by an isolated real-Postgres concurrent regression: proof-edge foreign-key inserts retain KEY SHARE on the same work item. Both clause transactions then requested FOR UPDATE in amendment propagation, deadlocking while upgrading against each other's KEY SHARE, even with one shared row and stable row ordering.
openDefect.recovery: Initial temporary execution mitigation retried only the two proven unchanged drafts sequentially. Durable fix now changes propagation to FOR NO KEY UPDATE, preserving payload-write serialization and compatibility with FK checks. The integration fixture now includes the production FK; its new barrier-based concurrent test fails with old source (40P01) and passes after the fix.
